title: Reuse QQ16 output slices under an explicit scratch-access contract
body:
PR2651 explicitly leaves owner-local scratch reuse in unproduced Y output slices open. This contribution supplies the conditional access/lifetime proof and exact word: borrow W0 for the C interval, then W0..W15 for F/G, one owner at a time. Both scalar-only intervals finish before any W output is produced. Under the stated exclusive, owner-aligned writable-slice contract, the maximum additionally allocated local payload arrays changes from 16 to 0.

Owned W contents may be arbitrarily dirty and disposable. All original first/last scratch CLEARs and future output CLEARs remain. All 224 outputs, 224 arbitrary borrowed current inputs and their physical frames, both checkpoints, and the full local invoice agree. There remain 224 owned full-cover output banks, 16 early retained values, 17,280 scalar primitives, 448 native events, 352 native rank mass, 480 wrappers and 208 cover maps. No arithmetic or native call is removed.

This is a conditional allocation refinement, not a memory minimum or a favorable physical/supplier budget. The caller must implement and price slice access, seeks, staging, retention, hosting, precision and output consumption. A layout requiring extra staging buffers retains that separate allocation. Outputs remain in F_U1, not the original pre-F0 frames. Revision 5's family gate stops at this handoff; no selected-frontier or kappa change.

Registered CPython 3.12.7 normal and optimized exact replays pass. A separate JSON-only checker executes owner-major scalar bodies over 2, 3 and 5 owners: 4,480 output cells and 78,400 component updates agree, with a wrong-owner rejection. Eight semantic controls plus Git-free export, source/candidate/typed-receipt corruption and overwrite refusal pass. Separate AI proof/code review and optimized primary/owner replays pass with no blocker. No human, formal-kernel, full native-kernel or selected cold replay is claimed.

Source: commdata2338 PR2651 `a3b82e6f4ddcf999f8b6dcd3a6dfc3a9543a1533`; credited PR2540/2511/2512 and Ali Romman/QQ16 lineage remain conditional. Exact source bytes are pinned. Latest main `6bd33bc0b87a01e9c9d8b1c01576f3ddbcaee850` changes no guidance, selected record or live input. Complete cached overlap covers 786 open PRs, 1,621 closed PRs and 1,303 Discussion records, supplemented by 100 recent all-state PRs. Discussion refresh is rate-limited; cache timestamps and coverage limits are recorded.

Prepared by ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. New material is Apache-2.0.

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/qq16-output-slice-scratch
```
